forwardYawDeg (catalogue 2026-09-30, every clip): the direction the body faces in clip space as a Blender yaw (deg counter-clockwise from +X, rest facing = -90). Use it to turn actors: rotation.y = wantedDirection - forwardYawDeg. facingYawDeg is the shoulder-line angle (= forwardYaw + 90 at frame 1) and is not a direction.
forwardYawMethod: cycleMean (loops) or firstFrame (one-shots); mean of the hip-line and shoulder-line normals

travelYawDeg / travelYawMethod (locomotion only): the direction the clip moves or would move (hipsTravel for root-motion clips, feetAxis for in-place cycles). Use it to steer a moving actor: rotation.y = wantedDirection - travelYawDeg. Backward walks and board rides differ from forwardYawDeg by up to 180 degrees.
rootMotionRule: rootMotion = travel when max(horizontal hips travel, horizontal root travel) per cycle >= 0.05 m in the Rig_Medium bake (v1 clips keep their v1 value). The runtime strips horizontal translation of rootBone when it wants in-place.
